[[Victo's Bulwark]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[The_Darkness_(boss)|The Darknesses]], three [[boss]]es in the [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings|Tomb of the Primeval Kings]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Health]] +30
